verdict.rationale: Slate installs as a global npm CLI (`npm i -g @randomlabs/slate`) and runs as a terminal TUI. Onboarding asks for your terminal background and model source. The docs cover in-terminal features: `!` shell execution, `@filename` references, `/sessions`, hotkeys, `/bug-report` from the TUI, and permission and yolo flags. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the local terminal install and run experience.
